runInstructions: 1. Extract this ZIP anywhere, for example C:\Tools\ozviewer.
2. Double-click ozviewer.exe, or run it from a command prompt with an image path.
3. No installer is run and no file associations, registry keys, shortcuts,
services, or other system settings are created or changed.
ozviewer.exe                     open an empty viewer window (Open / Ctrl+O / drag and drop)
ozviewer.exe <image>             open an image and keep the window open
ozviewer.exe --benchmark <image> emit timing JSONL after the first present, then exit
